rationale: The fixed implementation additionally releases the channel network namespace reference with put_net(pch->chan_net) and clears pch->chan_net. The Logic section does not describe this fixed-only cleanup. Its statements about validating the PPP association, clearing chan->ppp, synchronizing ongoing operations, disconnecting and unlinking the channel, waking waiters, decrementing the file reference count, and conditionally destroying the channel apply to both implementations.
